entities.summary: The Al-Muradiyya Mosque, also known as Murad Pasha Mosque, is a mosque located in the al-Rusufa district of Baghdad, in the Baghdad Governorate of Iraq. The mosque is situated in al-Maidan Square opposite the Ministry of Defense and an old citadel between al-Ahmadiyya Mosque and the Uzbek Mosque.
